populationServed.rationale: DoT administers national telecommunications policy and its grievance evidence covers broadly used telecom services.

grievanceRelevance.rationale: DARPG ranked DoT third with 55,014 grievance receipts from January through August 2025.

sourceCompleteness.rationale: Official sources identify a central RTI Cell, subject-specific CPIO and FAA designations, room details and the main service address, but the latest located matrix is outside the six-month freshness window.

filingAccessibility.rationale: DoT has a central RTI Cell for departmental applications and appeals and is served by the Central online and offline routes; separate attached authorities remain excluded.

maintainability.rationale: A stable dated subject matrix and centralized RTI Cell exist, but periodic person-level changes require a fresh designation-only verification before release.

notes: Promising launch candidate. Obtain a current official confirmation or replacement of the 5 December 2025 CPIO/FAA matrix, then encode designation-based subject routing without personal names or contact details. Exclude attached/subordinate public authorities unless separately verified.
